title: Mitigating Sycophancy in Decoder-Only Transformer Architectures: Synthetic Data Intervention
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of sycophancy (the tendency of models to cater to user preferences over objective facts) and proposes a synthetic data intervention method to mitigate it. While it mentions aligning models with 'human values', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral systems.
